title: QQQ Transition versus ex-post volatility-matched passive QQQ/BIL control

method.target: For each PR #438 sleeve, match its full-sample annualized daily volatility (sample standard deviation * sqrt(252)).
method.passive: No signal; monthly rebalance to a fixed QQQ/BIL target at the first session of each month, executing at adjusted Open.
method.execution: Adjusted Open = raw Open * AdjClose / raw Close; daily mark at AdjClose, exactly matching PR #438 price transformation.
method.costs: 10 bps per executed order leg; initial purchases uncharged to match PR #438's initial BIL reserve convention.
method.dividends: Embedded in adjusted prices, not separately credited in cash.
method.caveat: Matched weight is solved using the entire test period. This is an ex-post diagnostic, not a pre-registered allocation, out-of-sample test, or deployable rule.
